mapper.select: SELECT cs.id, c.name AS courseName, u.real_name AS teacherName, cs.room AS classroom, cs.color, cs.day AS weekday, cs.lesson AS lesson, cs.week AS weekJson, c.description AS memo FROM course_schedule cs LEFT JOIN course c ON c.id = cs.course_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = cs.teacher_id WHERE JSON_CONTAINS(cs.week, CAST(#{week} AS JSON)) AND cs.status = 1 AND c.status = 1 AND cs.class_id = ( SELECT class_id FROM sys_user WHERE id = #{studentId} ) ORDER BY cs.day, cs.lesson
